title: triage-filters
intention: The acceptance gate for the TRIAGE brick's output, installed in the build_inspector BEFORE the triage module exists — the fourth application of judges-before-the-judged. judge_triage (the pure judge, one implementation) reads the packet's decompose_ref berth and holds two claims: TRIAGE_COVERS_THE_SPLIT — the order is a complete permutation of the split's pieces, verbatim by what: nothing dropped, nothing invented, nothing double-ordered (a silent drop at triage is descoping without the word; descoping is a bounds question for Akien, never a ranking); TRIAGE_REASONS_THE_ORDER — every ordered entry carries its non-empty why_now (the ranking standard stated per piece, so the order can be adjudicated). The promotion-side mouths ride the one generalized _judge_charted wrapper; the future berth door composes judge_triage by identity, never the reverse.
why: Triage is where a builder either ranks the derived work or quietly reshapes it. The failure classes are dated: the 2026-07-24 done-while-unmoved substitution began as a triage defect — the expensive piece the chosen path implied was silently deprioritized out of existence and a cheaper invented one delivered in its place; and the standing get-it-right-not-cheap CC-- names the reflex that does it — ordering by cost-to-me, hidden in an unstated standard. The 2026-07-23 solidify-the-layer-below ruling (the rackmount flake ranked ahead of the librarian spine) is the counter-example that proves the cure: the honest order inverted the appealing one, and only its STATED why made the inversion adjudicable. So the physics: coverage is a multiset check against the berthed split (drop/invent/duplicate all deterministic), and the why_now is forced per entry — the standard travels with the rank.
traces_to: Law 8 — the brick that will emit orderings cannot shape its own acceptance; the judges exist and are sealed before the module is born
Law 3 — 'this first' is a claim; the forced why_now is what makes it challengeable against evidence
Law 6 — descoping belongs to the bounds' owner (Akien, via constrain's out), never to a silent drop at the ranking stage
Law 4 — get-it-right-not-cheap moves from memory-file discipline into schema physics

falsifier.proves_green: proof gate: teeth in build_inspector/proofs/test_inspector.py — a complete reasoned order passes quiet; an order dropping a split piece fires triage_covers_the_split naming every dropped piece; an order inventing a piece the split does not carry fires the same judge with the split's pieces in evidence; a why_now-less entry fires triage_reasons_the_order; a broken decompose_ref chain is a loud finding, never a silent pass; the two-mouths pin (judge called directly = judge behind the filters). Sealed under the tester before the module exists.
falsifier.proves_red: RED on any of: the triage module shaping these judges (the inspector importing from cairn.machines.chart, or the judge defined anywhere but the inspector); the door and the promotion gate disagreeing on one packet; a filter installed here without a dated failure behind it; the coverage check passing an order whose piece-counts differ from the berthed split's.
falsifier.horizon: re-read when the triage module lands under these judges (same arc); when a real ranking legitimately needs parallel tracks or a partial order (a design event, not a widening — v0 asserts a total order); when hypothesize lands (the ranked pieces become its subjects).
